correctness.rationale: The exact 32-facet complex has 48 edges. Over F2 the 32 triangle cocycle equations have rank 31, so Z1 has dimension 17; vertex coboundaries have rank 11, so H1 cohomology has dimension 6. The embedded verifier exhausts all 131072 cocycles, computes every class minimum and multiplicity, regenerates the 192-element group from the published generators, checks preservation of every facet, and exhausts the induced class and minimizing-support actions. The resulting nonzero class-orbit triples are (6,16,1), (10,24,4), (12,6,8), (14,16,18), and (16,1,12), with support-orbit partitions 16; 48+48; 24+24; 96+192; 12. No infinite statement is inferred from finite sampling.

value.rationale: The claim resolves the minimum edge-support problem for every nonzero F2 first-cohomology class of a canonical regular genus-three triangulation. It gives a complete symmetry-orbit spectrum rather than an arbitrary sample or a single minimum: 16 cosystolic classes have unique weight-6 representatives, while a unique invariant nonzero class first appears at weight 16. These data are natural combinatorial cosystolic invariants and are not implied by genus, Betti number, or the abstract automorphism-group order.
